title: LT FWD
infotainment: 11-inch driver info display + 17.7-inch center touchscreen, Google built-in (Google Maps, Google Assistant, Google Play). No Apple CarPlay / Android Auto support.
adasStandard: Chevy Safety Assist suite includes: Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Front Pedestrian Braking, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, IntelliBeam high-beam assist, and Following Distance Indicator. Source: [Chevrolet safety](https://www.chevrolet.com/electric/equinox-ev).
adasOptional: Adaptive Cruise Control, Rear Cross Traffic Braking, Blind Zone Steering Assist, HD Surround Vision, Rear Pedestrian Alert; Super Cruise available on LT with Active Safety 2 package (over 600,000 mi of compatible roads). Source: [Chevrolet Super Cruise](https://www.chevrolet.com/technology/super-cruise).
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard high-definition rearview camera with dynamic guidelines. Optional Rear Camera Mirror (digital rearview mirror) and HD Surround Vision (360-degree multi-camera).
sideViewCameraNotes: HD Surround Vision available (360-degree multi-camera). No Honda LaneWatch-style single-side camera. Trailering camera package not offered on Equinox EV.
subscriptionFeatures: OnStar plans (Connected Access, OnStar In-Vehicle, OnStar Super Cruise) gate most connected features. Super Cruise: 3-yr trial included, then ~$25-65/month depending on tier. No subscription gating of heated seats, performance, or range as of MY2025.
drmNotes: Vehicle drives without cellular connectivity, but most convenience and ADAS features depend on OnStar. Super Cruise stops working after the 3-year OnStar Super Cruise trial unless renewed (~$25-65/month). Remote start, in-vehicle apps, OTA updates, and navigation require an active OnStar plan. GM uses Android Automotive OS / Google built-in for infotainment (no Apple CarPlay or Android Auto). Sources: [OnStar plans](https://gmauthority.com/blog/2025/05/gm-revises-onstar-plans-and-pricing/), [FTC v. GM data sharing settlement](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/01/ftc-takes-action-against-general-motors-sharing-drivers-precise-location-driving-behavior-data).
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving kill switch installed; NHTSA rule for IIJA Section 24220 is not yet finalized. The driver-attention camera supporting Super Cruise is hardware that could plausibly be used by GM to implement a behavioral-based detection if mandated. OnStar Stolen Vehicle Slowdown (opt-in) can remotely slow a stolen vehicle but is unrelated to impaired-driver detection.
knownIssues: Early build months had software bugs (infotainment lag, charging session interruptions). Recall on rear-suspension toe-link bolts and a software recall for instrument-cluster blackout were issued in 2024-2025. No Apple CarPlay / Android Auto has been a major complaint in reviews. Sources: [NHTSA recalls](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
recalls: Multiple low-volume recalls during 2024-2025 production ramp (rear-suspension bolt torque, instrument-cluster software). See NHTSA VIN-lookup at [nhtsa.gov/recalls](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
stateIncentives: Eligible for state incentives in CA (CVRP wound down 2023; CARB Clean Vehicle Assistance program available), CO ($5k state credit through 2025), NY ($2k Drive Clean), MA ($3.5k MOR-EV), NJ (sales tax exemption), and others - eligibility depends on income and assembly location. Built at GM Ramos Arizpe (Mexico) initially, with US assembly shifting to Fairfax, KS. Federal IRA point-of-sale credit eligible for 2025 deliveries assembled in NA with compliant battery sourcing.
tcoSource: Depreciation: KBB 2025 Equinox EV LT 1 5-year depreciation ($23,851 — the lowest-MSRP FWD configuration, matching this trim). Insurance ($12,030), fuel ($2,245), maintenance ($1,673) from CarEdge Chevrolet Equinox EV cost-to-own (model-level). CarEdge bundles maintenance + repairs as 'maintenance' — `tcoRepairs` omitted. Financing at 72-mo / 6.99% APR / 20% down on $34,995 (MSRP $33,600 + dest $1,395) → $27,996 financed → ~$5,466 interest. Taxes & fees not consistently published; omitted. Sources: https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/equinox-ev/2025/lt-1/ , https://www.kbb.com/chevrolet/equinox-ev/2025/cost-to-own/ , https://caredge.com/chevrolet/equinox-ev/cost-to-own
